tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Other Conditions as per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must produce satisfactory experience certificates from customers for the LMO Installation on Turnkey basis with a capacity of 13Kl or more at least from 4 Government Medical College and Hospital in Karnataka-relevant Document should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have all together minimum manufacturing capacity of 400 tons per day and valid relevant document should be uploaded &Valid manufacturing license must be uploaded and provided, or else bidder will be disqualified.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder must have minimum 20 or more cryogenic road tankers (VITT) with CCOE license for Liquid oxygen to avoid any emergency or pandemic like covid,relevant Document should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have scheduling center for online monitoring of Liquid Medical Oxygen (TMS) installed in the tank, to get an accurate online monitoring of liquid level 24x7. Tracker should be able to produce daily consumption data is manage Hospital identity any abrupt consumption or any malfunction, the same has been acknowledged by the Govt. PESO. The bidder must submit the monthly report system Generated report of the day wise consumption as per data given in telemetry-certification to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- scheduling center for online monitoring

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have 5 nos of higher capacity vessel installations in Govt. Hospitals on turnkey basis (higher capacity i.e., 6 kl and above) and 5 higher capacity installations in private hospital, end user certificates should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder must have 5 nos of higher capacity vessel installations

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have minimum 7-8 times more storage capacity of the peak LMO consumption (60 Tons per month) at RIMS which is 480 tons during normal days excluding Covid consumption relevant Document should be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- minimum 7-8 times more storage capacity

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have 5 or more letter of recognition as proof of supply of liquid medical oxygen for supply of 50 tons for every month to hospital of 650 bed or more in Karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- must have 5 or more letter of recognition as proof of supply of liquid medical oxygen
